contact.basis: Dry Broad Street threshold footway,1.2m outside main facade and3.8m north of its midpoint, chosen before source ground/geometry. Public ground rises toward New Street; exact paving/door levels remain approximate.

verticalDatum: Source-specific USGS NY_CMPG_2013 one-metre DEM; provider catalog NAVD88. No local survey-datum transformation; model uses provider-relative dry footway datum.
attribution: USGS National Map3DEP, NY_CMPG_2013 source-specific elevation export
method: Original uncompressed F32 GeoTIFF preserved before model geometry; explicit locked dataset30939 with no visualization function. Pillow pixel reader used for build; independent stdlib TIFF decoder compares every original pixel and reproduces all derived sample values. Pixel-centre bilinear sampling in native geographic frame; no flattening or fitting.
limitations: One-metre source/export and one-metre review sampling do not establish surveyed foundation contact. Hidden foundations, paving interpolation and later site changes remain uncertain.
Provider catalog acquisition2014-04-21 is source metadata, not an independent local field survey.
Source is a catalog-selected urban bare-earth DEM, not a facade or sidewalk survey; default coarse Earth terrain compatibility is not certified.
